message: The other day, I was packing some essentials into our go-bags, and I thought, why not get the family involved? So, I sent a little message in our group chat asking everyone what they'd want in case of an emergency. The responses were a mix of serious and funny—my grandson suggested snacks, of course, while my daughter reminded me to pack the dog’s favorite toy. 😊 It turned into a lovely bonding moment, and we ended up making a plan together. It’s funny how a little prep can spark such connection, isn’t it?
